description.narrative: Power Shift Africa is a climate and energy think tank established in 2018 to provide policy,advocacy and communications from an African perspective to educate and inform withinAfrica and amplify the African moral voice into the international climate arena.PSA’s mission is to mobilise climate action in Africa, amplify African voices throughpresenting a united, well-evidenced message to governments, other stakeholders and themedia, to support a shift in climate and energy policies towards low-carbon and resilientalternatives, and increased efforts on media and public communications, and leverage thisvoice internationally.Furthermore, Power Shift Africa works with a diverse and rich network of civil society actors,scientists, and community groups. The aim of bringing these groups together is to buildcommon positions and understanding of the need for urgent climate action. And, also toestablish working relations that would yield effective results and the much-needed systemicchange.The combination of trusted policy analysis, excellent media contacts and the added value ofworking with Africa Movement of Movements means PSA and the Africa Movement ofMovements is well placed to produce and land impactful policy, advocacy and media efforts.
